subject: Gateway crew handovers for SF Ignite — layover & shuttle details
messages:
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Michael Rivera <michael@eventops.co>, GroupRes Harborside <groupres@harborside.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Gateway crew handovers for SF Ignite — initial plan

Michael / Harborside team,

Thanks again for building the layover point into the schedule. We have a compact crew coming in on staggered flights Friday night and early Saturday AM; want to confirm a smooth handover so we don’t have gaps on the 9am setup shift. Quick ask: can Harborside confirm a holding area (near loading dock B) for late arrivals and one on-site phone or radio channel for real-time handoffs?

Attached is the latest crew manifest (v4) with flight times and contact numbers. Please confirm shuttle capacity from SFO to the venue for the 11:15p–1:30a arrival window — the vendor (JetBridge) previously quoted two minibuses and one extra sprinter. If that’s no longer available, tell us now and we’ll rebook.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Field Marketing Ops | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: crew_manifest_v4.xlsx (roster), shuttle_rfp_notes.txt
From: Michael Rivera <michael@eventops.co>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: GroupRes Harborside <groupres@harborside.com>, JetBridge Ops <ops@jetbridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gateway crew handovers for SF Ignite — initial plan

Hi Sofia —

Confirmed: loading dock B is available for late arrivals and we can reserve the adjacent holding room (Room B2) until 7:00am. I’ve looped JetBridge to confirm the shuttle roster. They replied off-thread that they can provide two 15-seat vans and one 12-seat sprinter for the 11:15p–1:30a window, plus one standby driver.

Two notes from Harborside: 1) they need expected drop-off order by Thursday EOD to stage equipment, and 2) any vehicles exceeding 22ft require advance parking permits (not the case for your vans).

Will send shuttle itinerary once JetBridge confirms names and license plates.

—Michael
Michael Rivera
Event Operations | EventOps Co.
michael@eventops.co

Sofia / team,

Quick update from the field: Marcus pinged me — Flight UA 342 (Marcus) got rebooked inbound and now has a long layover in SFO (arrives 10:50p instead of 7:30p). That pushes his availability for the 11pm shuttle into the later sprinter window. I recommend:

- Move Marcus to the sprinter (12-seat) so the earlier vans keep to the larger check-in crew.
- Marissa, can you take point on swapping Marcus’s on-site handset with Priya’s kit at the holding room? We’ll need someone to brief him on the booth set on arrival.

I’ll update the manifest in Drive after I get the new flight confirmation.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

- Aditya: you own the manifest at check-in and will sign people off for 9am setup. Please have printed copies (2) at dock B — I’ll bring one as backup.

Sofia / Michael / Redwood team,

Attached final shuttle manifest and driver details. Drivers will be parked curbside C at SFO for the 11:15p pickup and will standby until 1:45a in case of late arrivals. Vehicle IDs and driver cell numbers are included in shuttle_itinerary_may18.pdf. Please confirm receipt so we can release permits with Harborside tomorrow morning.

One operational reminder: we will do a handoff check — Team lead (Marissa) signs off on crew count when the sprinter arrives. Driver will wait a maximum of 12 minutes after scheduled arrival before reporting late to dispatch.

Safe travels —
